This is hymn number 290 titled "Rejoice, Ye Saints of Latter Days" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by A. Laurence Lyon and the lyrics were written by Alfred M. Durham.
